notablePrerequisites: Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
 When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Bloodghast trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
